text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fan mail had arrived for Mejiro Palmer,
so I handed it to her in the trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Getting fan mail
makes all the hard work feel worth it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer happily opened the letter, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "This letter was from a friend I met during a freestyle race."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, they told me "I'll send you a fan letter sometime" recently,
but to think they'd actually send one...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what they wrote...
Probably just teasing, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Um... "I went to see you run in the
Twinkle Series.
You've got some great moves!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"‘You're like a different person compared to the Palmer
we always goof off with. You look cooler when you're quiet ☆’
See~? I knew they'd tease me~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"‘People always say Palmer is all about runaway leads
and stuff, but’—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "To me, it looked like you faced it with dignity. Keep giving it your all!" ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't compliment me so sincerely.
You sound like a genuine fan letter, jeez."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get training...!
Give me a slightly heavier menu today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna invite them to come watch my race again!
And next time, I'll show 'em an even crazier runaway victory!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From that day on, Mejiro Palmer devoted herself to training with even greater zeal.
